ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud in Minnesota, including the impact of obsolete systems and lack of government support on families.
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How do obsolete systems contribute to the problem?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for improved systems and government support. By analyzing data and following the money, we can identify key players and patterns that may be contributing to the problem.
